cross_references.title: Right against unreasonable searches and seizures
cross_references.relationship: companion — Section 13 protects against unreasonable government searches; Section 1 protects privacy broadly against all actors. Together they form the two pillars of California constitutional privacy protection.

cross_references.title: Bane Act — civil action for interference with rights
cross_references.relationship: enforcement mechanism — the Bane Act provides a statutory cause of action when someone interferes with Article I, Section 1 rights through threats, intimidation, or coercion. Section 1 declares the right; Section 52.1 provides the teeth.

cross_references.title: Civil action for deprivation of rights under color of law
cross_references.relationship: federal counterpart for government violations — when the privacy violator is a state actor, both Article I Section 1 and 42 USC 1983 may apply. Section 1983 requires state action; Article I Section 1 does not. They are often pleaded together against government defendants.
